title: Sprout Social Review (2026)
intro: Sprout Social is evaluated here as Marketing & Growth software — Sprout Social is a premium social media management suite for publishing, engagement (Smart Inbox), listening add-ons, and analytics. Published pricing (2026-08-17): Essentials from $79/seat/mo (annual), Standard from $199, Professional from $299, Advanced from $399; Enterprise custom. 30-day free trial marketed. Confirm live monthly rates and profile limits. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s marketing methodology (ease of use, campaign/content tools, marketing automation, funnel/conversion, analytics, brand monitoring, integrations, scalability, value, AI). It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Sprout Social when premium social suite analytics and customer care inbox matter more than scheduler price.
verdict: Choose Sprout Social when premium social suite analytics and customer care inbox matter more than scheduler price. Compare Hootsuite for alternate major suite, Buffer for mainstream scheduler value, Brand24/Meltwater for listening-first, and Agorapulse for mid-market inbox. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging on the vendor site before purchase.
